scope: source-only precredential image trust boundary; no final image reviewed

evidence: Both workflows download and load a runtime archive without a checkout-side comparison to the independently reviewed archive SHA.
Their first integrity check runs the downloaded image own Python verifier.
A substitute image could return success and then receive MISTRAL_API_KEY in the next workflow step.
finding.required_fix: Authenticate review/proof/reference-or-receipt and actual archive bytes in trusted checkout code before docker load/run; keep image self-verification only as an additional check.
